tokenizer_note: Proxy count. This repo does not call a provider API, so these are not Grok, Claude, or GPT usage fields.

grok-4.6.note: The public xAI price card lists grok-4.6 and does not list grok-4.7. This session's model is Grok 4.7; dollar figures use the nearest published card.
grok-4.6.cache: Automatic prefix match from the start of the messages array. No explicit breakpoints on the pages fetched. x-grok-conv-id is recommended so requests stick to one server. Minimum cacheable length is not published there.

claude-opus-4.7.cache: Explicit cache_control breakpoints (max 4) or one top-level automatic breakpoint. Default TTL 5 minutes, optional 1 hour. Writes cost 1.25x (5m) or 2x (1h). Reads cost 0.1x.

claude-opus-5.5.cache: Same breakpoint model as other current Claude models. Cache reads are 0.05x base input.

gpt-5.6.cache: Automatic prefix caching. Explicit breakpoints exist. Cache writes are 1.25x uncached input; reads are 0.1x. TTL at least 30 minutes. Base dollar rates were not on the page fetched.

per_request_usage.reason: Nothing in this repo assembles model requests or reads API usage fields.

illustrative_scenario.note: Not measured. No production traces exist in this repo. Used only to turn a token count into a per-task dollar range for the repo-controlled prefix.
